meta.title: MarkX — compare prices, buy from trusted shops
meta.description: Compare phone and electronics prices from verified Addis Ababa shops. See the total to your door and pay after you inspect.

search.label: Search products
search.tryAgain: Check the spelling, try fewer words, or browse a category.
search.requestTitle: Can't find it? Ask for it
search.requestBody: Tell us what you are looking for. Our catalogue team reads every request.
search.requestPhone: Your phone, if you want an answer (optional)
search.requestSent: Thank you. Your request was sent.
search.requestFailed: We could not send that. Check the phone number and try again.

home.heading: Compare prices from trusted shops
home.lead: One product, every shop's price, with delivery to your door added in.
home.protection1: Every shop is checked by MarkX before it can sell.
home.protection2: See the total with delivery before you order.
home.protection3: Pay after you inspect, and give your code only when the goods are right.

product.noOffers: No shop offers this version right now.
product.zoneAny: Choose your area to see delivery
product.addFailed: That offer could not be added. Refresh and try again.

footer.about: MarkX compares prices from verified shops in Addis Ababa. MarkX never holds your money.

errors.notFound: We could not find that page.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.lead: Use your phone number. We send you a six-digit code; no password needed.

auth.failed: That did not work. Check the number or the code and try again.

auth.devHint: Development build: codes are written to the local SMS inbox, not sent.

seller.title: Seller dashboard
seller.notSeller: This account does not run a shop on MarkX.
seller.notMember: You are not a member of this shop.
seller.answerLate: The time to answer has passed
seller.declineReason: Why can you not fulfil it?

seller.codeLocked: Too many wrong codes. Ask MarkX to issue the buyer a new code.

seller.checkIn: All my prices and stock are still right
seller.reviewsNone: No buyer has reviewed your shop yet.
seller.reviewsLead: Buyers rate the product and your shop after an order is completed. You cannot remove a review, but you can reply once and change your reply later.
seller.replyHint: Only published reviews can be answered.
seller.photosLead: Real photos from your shop help buyers trust your listing. MarkX removes the location and camera details, and shows a photo once it is ready.

seller.photoReceived: Received. The photo shows once it is ready.
seller.missingTitle: Before you can send your application
seller.submitted: Sent. MarkX will review your shop and tell you.
seller.applyLead: Tell us about your business. Next you add documents and a payout account; MarkX checks everything before your shop opens to buyers.
seller.notInvited: Selling on MarkX is by invitation for now. If someone from MarkX invited you, sign in with the phone number they invited.
seller.legalName: Legal name, as on the licence
seller.storeSlugHint: Small letters, numbers and dashes, like merkato-phones.
seller.documentsLead: Only you and the MarkX staff who check shops can open these. A clear photo of each document: JPEG, PNG or WebP.
seller.docExpires: Expires on (if it has a date)
seller.teamLead: People who help run your shop sign in with their own phone number. MarkX tells you if a role is not offered yet.
seller.storeAreas: Areas you deliver to, one per line
seller.legalLead: MarkX checks these. Buyers see your shop name and address, never your tax or licence numbers.
seller.payoutLead: Where you are paid, in your own name. A new account waits a few days before it replaces the one in use, so a stolen sign-in cannot quietly redirect your money.
seller.addOfferLead: Find the product in the MarkX catalogue, then say its condition, price and stock.
seller.addOfferNone: No product matched. MarkX adds products to the catalogue; ask MarkX if yours is missing.
seller.addOfferCollection: The buyer collects at the shop
seller.addOfferLowStock: Warn me when stock is at or below
seller.performanceLead: MarkX's own figures for your shop. Orders received are those placed in the period; the rest is what happened in it.
seller.closeLead: Closing is final: the shop page and its offers disappear and the shop cannot be opened again. Finish, decline or cancel every open order first.
seller.closeConfirm: I understand this cannot be undone
seller.locationHint: Buyers see a map link to the shop. Stand in the shop and use your phone's location, or type the numbers.
seller.locationFailed: The phone did not give a location. Type it in or try again.
seller.proposeTitle: Suggest a product for the catalogue
seller.proposeLead: MarkX checks every suggestion and may merge it with a product it already has. Once approved, add your offer for it.
seller.proposeLink: Not in the catalogue? Suggest it

admin.title: MarkX staff
admin.signInLead: Password and the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
admin.signInFailed: That did not work. Check the phone, the password and the code.
admin.notStaff: This page is for MarkX staff only.
admin.goodsReturned: The goods are physically back at the shop (stock returns to sale)
admin.reason: Written reason (both sides see the outcome)
admin.reissue: Issue the buyer a new handover code
admin.level2: Level 2: documents checked and shop visited
admin.payoutMatches: The payout account name matches the legal name
admin.noAccess: Your role has no work queue here yet.
admin.noProposals: No product is waiting for review.
admin.noOffers: No live offer on that product.
admin.productNotFound: No approved product has that link name.
admin.filterAction: Action (end with a dot for a whole group)
admin.auditLead: Every recorded action, by staff, people and the system, newest first. Nothing here can be changed.
admin.notAllowed: Your role may not open this page.
admin.noDispatch: Nothing is waiting to leave a shop.
admin.moderationReason: Written reason (kept in the audit log)
admin.resolutionNote: Note for the record (reporters are told the outcome)
admin.allOnTarget: Close every open report on the same thing
admin.settingsLead: Every change is kept in the audit trail with its value before and after. Operations may change only the risk limits.
admin.readOnly: Your role may not change this
admin.secretLead: Give it to the new member of staff in person to add to their authenticator app. It is not shown again; if it is lost, create the account again.
admin.secretUri: Or this link, for apps that read one:
admin.sessionsEnd: A new role or switching off ends this person's staff sessions at once.
admin.exportsLead: CSV files for whole days in Addis Ababa time, at most 366 days. No buyer's name, phone or address is in them. Every export is kept in the audit trail.
admin.exportFees: Fees charged on completed shop orders
admin.exportSellerOrders: Shop orders placed, with their money and outcome
admin.exportSellerBalances: What each shop owes at the end of the period
admin.picturesLead: Every picture of a product in every state. A new picture is cleaned and rendered by the worker before buyers see it.
admin.noPictures: This product has no picture yet.
admin.removeReason: Why (the seller is told if it is theirs)
admin.level3: Level 3: a track record at level 2
admin.suspendHint: Its listings leave the marketplace at once and it cannot accept new orders; orders it already accepted carry on.
admin.deliveryLead: Buyers choose an area at checkout; its zone sets the delivery fee and the promised time for each way of delivering. Collecting at the shop is always free.
admin.linkTitle: Use an attribute in a category
admin.linkVariant: It tells versions apart (like storage or colour)
admin.termsLead: A product or offer whose name contains one of these words is refused.

heldReason.contact_details: contains a phone number or a link
heldReason.many_reviews_of_one_seller: many reviews of one shop by one buyer
